scope: New Indianapolis, Marion County, Central Indiana, and Indiana resources not present in the 2026-07-30 seed catalog

records.name: ICAN Assistance Center and Food Pantry
records.description: Provides emergency food and hygiene supplies, clothing, limited transportation assistance, food cards when available, and referrals for Indianapolis east-side residents.
records.availability_notes: Bus passes, tickets, and food cards are subject to availability; pantry eligibility and hours should be checked before referral.

records.name: Southeast Community Services
records.description: Provides a food pantry, employment and financial coaching, GED and English-language classes, family programs, benefits navigation, and referrals for housing and transportation.

records.name: Child Care Answers
records.description: Helps Central Indiana families find and pay for child care and supports child-care providers with business resources, quality improvement, shared services, and grant opportunities.
records.availability_notes: CCDF and grant availability can change; current waitlists and application rounds require verification.

records.name: PACE Indianapolis
records.description: Provides pre-release and post-release reentry planning, coordinated case management, basic-needs support, employment preparation, financial coaching, peer recovery support, and family services.

records.name: Indianapolis Urban League Entrepreneurship Center
records.description: Supports prospective and existing minority-owned businesses through workshops, coaching, industry credentials, capital and procurement connections, revenue growth, and business-expansion support.

records.name: Flagship Enterprise Capital
records.description: Provides fair and affordable small-business loans and technical-assistance connections for underserved Indiana entrepreneurs, including access to specialized business funds.
records.availability_notes: Loan eligibility, rates, terms, and fund availability require current underwriting review.

records.name: Partners IN Food and Farming Technical Assistance Network
records.description: Connects Indiana farmers, food businesses, and food-system leaders with coaching and specialized support for business planning, market access, cooperative development, funding strategies, regenerative agriculture, and value-chain coordination.

records.name: Kheprw Institute Growin' Good in the Hood
records.description: Offers no-cost urban farming plots, basic supplies and equipment, mentorship, and seed-to-harvest education for Indianapolis community members interested in cultivating food.
records.availability_notes: Plot capacity and application timing must be checked before referral.

records.name: Kheprw Institute Urban Agri-Culture Learning Lab
records.description: Provides community learning in aquaponics, urban gardening, urban farming, food justice, youth leadership, health, and entrepreneurship in Indianapolis.

records.name: Felege Hiywot Center Youth Farm Initiative
records.description: Provides Indianapolis youth with hands-on urban farming, leadership, teamwork, service, sustainability, and practical business-learning experiences.

records.name: Indianapolis Housing Agency
records.description: Administers local public-housing and housing-assistance programs and provides Indianapolis residents with tenant-rights, housing, food, and community-resource information.
records.availability_notes: Housing-program waitlists and intake availability require current verification.

records.name: InteCare Veterans Services
records.description: Supports veterans experiencing or at risk of homelessness through housing stabilization and connections to food, communication, and other essential resources.
